name: tnt-by-fire
comment: WP-1.6g. TNT at (0, 61, 0) on a stone platform at y = 60, fire set at (1, 61, 0). BlockFire.tryToCatchBlockOnFire reaches the TNT (abilityToCatchFire 100, BlockFire.java:21) and calls Block.tnt.onBlockDestroyedByPlayer(world, x, y, z, 1) (BlockFire.java:118-131), which spawns an EntityTNTPrimed with fuse 80 and plays random.fuse (BlockTNT.java:45-56); the primed TNT (lit at t = 79) then explodes at about t = 159 (Explosion). Needs BlockFire (WP-1.6b), EntityTNTPrimed (WP-2.4) and Explosion (WP-1.8).
